text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=redwood-inference-prod, alert=5xx_error_rate, threshold=2.5% over 2m. PD: <https://pd.example.com/incidents/RED-9931|RED-9931> — routing to on-call.
maya: @here acked via PagerDuty — I'm oncall for inference-prod. Pulling metrics + logs now.
sam: looking at edge-gateway (edge-proxy) dashboards — big spike in 502/503 starting ~2m ago, traffic concentrated in eu-west1-a.
devon: no deploys in last 40m from CI. Checked canary tags.
nora: sending quick customer check: streaming latency / dropped connections telemetry shows uptick for a handful of customers.
maya: running runbook step 1: check backend GPU pool health and KV cache evictions. Starting with `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep edge-proxy` to identify pods.
maya: command: ```kubectl logs inference/edge-proxy-3 -n inference --since=5m | tail -n 200``` — seeing repeated `upstream prematurely closed connection` and `context deadline exceeded`.
sam: same in proxy logs: a flood of 429->502 fallthroughs. Also seeing increased `x-envoy-upstream-rq-timeout`.
maya: checking node metrics — network egress saturation? `ifstat` looks normal. CPU on the probe nodes trending up but not pegged.
devon: kvcache dashboard: small burst of evictions at the same timestamp. Could be cache hotkeying causing backend overload.
jordan: adding note: customer-facing impact: streaming connections may drop; API request error rate peaked at ~3.2% but P95 latency stable. No widespread data loss reported.
maya: executing canary mitigation: restart two edge-proxy pods one at a time to recycle connections and warm caches.
sam: restarting edge-proxy-3 now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n inference --selector=zone=eu-west1-a --grace-period=30` — will observe.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: RED-9931 acknowledged by maya (on-call).
maya: restarted pod edge-proxy-3-7f9, then edge-proxy-5-c21. Error rate dropped to ~1.0% within 60s.
devon: deploying temporary Envoy rate-limit tweak to reduce backend pressure — patch applied to route-level config: ```- match: prefix: "/v1/stream"  rate_limits: 200r/s``` — small throttle for heavy streams.
nora: added 10m suppression window on the 5xx alert to avoid noise while we observe.
jordan: notifying CS rotation: pinging account owners for any anomalies. cc @cs-rotation.
maya: monitoring: token/call traces show success for previously failing requests now. KV eviction count stabilized.
sam: leaving a note to investigate why cache hotkeys aligned with increased client concurrency — possible batching regression in client library.
pagerduty-bot: RED-9931 status update: acknowledged by maya; no escalation. link: <https://pd.example.com/incidents/RED-9931|PD RED-9931>
maya: plan: 1) monitor 15m; 2) remove temporary rate-limit after stability; 3) open follow-up ticket for KV cache investigation and client-side batching review.
devon: creating follow-up: TICKET-2156 — "Investigate KV eviction spike correlated with 5xx surge (eu-west1-a)".
nora: suggest adding synthetic check for streaming endpoint tail latency to catch this earlier.
maya: marking incident as mitigated — error rate back under threshold and customer errors largely resolved. Closing PD incident in 5m if no regression. :white_check_mark:
jordan: thanks all — quick postmortem later, but good coordination. :thumbsup:
